feeds.title: British Athletics
feeds.description: The official site of Athletics in the UK. Our mission is to share the latest news and action with fans of the number one Olympic and Paralympic sport in an accessible and engaging way. As it states in our house rules, we encourage interaction, constructive criticism and debate and will endeavor to actively engage with our online following.

feeds.title: Athletics Weekly
feeds.description: Athletics Weekly Magazine stands as the UK's top destination for all things running and athletics, boasting a vibrant online presence, a leading print publication, and an engaging social media community. Catering to runners, athletes, and fans worldwide, it offers comprehensive coverage of road racing, track and field, and various running disciplines. Stay informed with the latest news, event reports, and results, both locally and globally, making it the ultimate choice for dedicated enthusiasts.

feeds.title: Scottish Athletics
feeds.description: Scottish Athletics is the national governing body for athletics in Scotland, established in 2001.

feeds.title: British Athletics Archives - runblogrun
feeds.description: RunBlogRun covers the global sport of athletics, sports and ethics, and the global fascination with the Olympics.

feeds.title: Neuff Athletic Equipment » Athletics Products Guides
feeds.description: Everything you need to know about Athletics Equipment! Includes product reviews, guides on choosing the right athletics equipment and more - all designed to help you make the right choices and get the best for your money. New articles added regularly.

feeds.title: Track & Field Tours Blog
feeds.description: Track and Field Tours, led by owner David Barnett, has been a prominent athletics event and sports tour operator since 1991. With a wealth of experience dating back to 1983, they specialize in organizing tours for major international athletic competitions, including the Olympics, World Championships, and more.

feeds.title: Running Tracks UK
feeds.description: Here at running tracks UK, our speciality is installing athletics facilities within the country.

feeds.title: BestAthletics Blog
feeds.description: It shares easy-to-follow tips for runners, like how to train better, recover from injuries, and run in tough conditions. The blog also features success stories, athlete spotlights, and advice from coaches.

feeds.title: HIGH5
feeds.description: HIGH5 is a UK company run by athletes. High5 combine the latest developments in sports nutrition with years of racing experience to help you perform at your very best, no matter what your ability
